system.description: While transformed into ash via Ashes to Ashes, you retain full consciousness and limited movement, and may use any Disciplines a pile of dust could still perform (no Dominate without eyes, but effects like Majesty remain possible). Winds cannot scatter you and you cannot easily be separated - doing so requires a Physical Challenge where each level of your Fortitude or Potence counts as two extra Traits to resist. You may move against the wind, and may flatten yourself to slip beneath doors or through small cracks; otherwise this functions exactly like Ashes to Ashes.
